1.
 
KHAMA
 
GHANI
 
SA:
 
WELCOME
 
TO
 
THE
 
PINK
 
CITY
 
Jaipur
 
is
 
not
 
merely
 
a
 
capital;
 
it
 
is
 
a
 
living
 
masterpiece
 
of
 
18th-century
 
urban
 
planning,
 
a
 
city
 
where
 
scientific
 
precision
 
meets
 
artistic
 
opulence.
 
Founded
 
in
 
1727
 
by
 
the
 
visionary
 
Maharaja
 
Sawai
 
Jai
 
Singh
 
II,
 
Jaipur
 
was
 
conceived
 
as
 
a
 
testament
 
to
 
Enlightenment
 
ideals,
 
earning
 
its
 
place
 
as
 
a
 
UNESCO
 
World
 
Heritage
 
site.
 
Its
 
iconic
 
"Pink
 
City"
 
moniker
 
was
 
born
 
of
 
a
 
grand
 
royal
 
gesture
 
in
 
1876,
 
when
 
the
 
city
 
was
 
bathed
 
in
 
a
 
traditional
 
terracotta-pink
 
wash
 
to
 
welcome
 
the
 
Prince
 
of
 
Wales—a
 
hue
 
that
 
remains
 
today
 
as
 
a
 
symbol
 
of
 
hallowed
 
hospitality
 
and
 
enduring
 
heritage.
“As
 
your
 
concierge
 
through
 
these
 
storied
 
gates,
 
I
 
invite
 
you
 
to
 
see
 
Jaipur
 
not
 
as
 
a
 
relic
 
of
 
a
 
vanished
 
era,
 
but
 
as
 
a
 
vibrant
 
narrative
 
written
 
in
 
sandstone
 
and
 
spice.
 
Every
 
archway
 
here
 
tells
 
a
 
story
 
of
 
a
 
kingdom
 
that
 
dared
 
to
 
dream
 
in
 
geometry
 
and
 
color.”
 
—
 
Message
 
from
 
Your
 
Licensed
 
Guide

the

of

founding
 
decree,

heart,

stone

with
